settings.about.summary: Chimer {version} — a sound scheme manager for Windows 10 and 11. Applying a pack writes to the Windows registry for real, always behind an automatic backup.
settings.checkFailed: Could not check the native capability
settings.checking: Checking access to the Windows registry…
settings.credit.after: for the archive of classic Windows sound schemes.
settings.languageDesc: The app follows your system language unless you pick one here.
settings.limit.apply: Applying a pack writes to HKCU\AppEvents\Schemes\Apps — no administrator rights, no system files touched.
settings.limit.backups: Every apply snapshots the events it touches first, so any change can be rolled back from Backups.
settings.limit.catalog: The pack library and the audio previews come from a real, publicly hosted catalog (30 classic schemes). Packs from any other origin play a synthesized tone instead of the file.
settings.limit.events: Events per pack reflect the real files of each scheme — not every pack covers every event.
settings.limit.wired: Applying is verified after the fact: the registry is read back and any mismatch is reported.
